description: This file declares the Response class as part of the WebSockets::JsonRpc namespace. The class manages JSON-RPC response messages, providing methods to access message ID, result, error, and validity status. It inherits from a base Message class and prevents copying.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC response message, providing methods to access response details such as ID, result, error, and validation status.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the response message.

methods.name: isResult
methods.description: Checks if the response contains a result.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result JSON object if present.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the response contains an error.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Retrieves the error JSON object if present.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Determines if the response message is valid.
